E-PARADA: CROSS-FUNCTIONAL SYSTEM SUBROUTINES & MODULE WORKFLOWS
Detailed procedural logic for core platform subroutines: Auth, Availability Engine, QR Checkpoint, Overstay Billing, RTC & Auditing

SUBROUTINE 1

AUTH & KYC
PIPELINE

• Multipart Payload Parsing
• Bcrypt Password Hashing
• Sanctum Token Issuance
• Secure KYC Storage
• Admin Approval Action

Driver/Host Register Input
Provide Credentials + Multipart Uploads
(id_image, vehicle_photo, plate_number)

Subroutine: validatePayload()
• Check email uniqueness, regex, required files
• Verify MIME types (jpeg, png, pdf) < 5MB

Return 422 JSON Errors
Send field-specific error messages to client

Subroutine: persistUserAndFiles()
• Hash password via bcrypt(rounds=12)
• Store encrypted private files to storage/app/kyc
• Insert users (verification_status: 'pending')

Database: users & vehicles
INSERT INTO users & INSERT INTO vehicles
with initial quotas & remaining_vehicle_slots=3

Admin Subroutine: reviewKYC()
Fetch private images & compare ID to vehicle plate

SUBROUTINE 2

REAL-TIME
AVAILABILITY &
CONFLICT ENGINE

• Operating Hours Verification
• Slot Vehicle Matrix Match
• Overlap Reservation Filter
• Real-Time Slot Locking
• Estimated Fare Calculator

Driver Request Availability
Input: space_id, vehicle_id, start/end date & time
[GET /driver/parking-spaces/{id}/availability]

Subroutine: checkOperatingHours()
Verify if target window is within opening/closing hours
(or if space is_open_24_hours=true)

Return Closed Alert
Facility is closed during the requested time window

Subroutine: filterCompatibleSlots()
Match vehicle_type against parking_slots.vehicle_types
Extract candidate slot IDs

Database: Overlapping Reservations
SELECT slot_id FROM reservations WHERE space_id=?
AND status IN ('pending','confirmed','checked_in')
AND NOT (end_time <= :req_start OR start_time >= :req_end)

Return 422 Slot Conflict
All compatible slots are booked. Return alternative times

Display Available Slots & Cost Quote
Driver views available slot list, pricing, and Book CTA

Subroutine: createReservationLock()
Insert reservation (status: 'pending') with unique token
Trigger DB row lock / transaction to prevent race conditions

SUBROUTINE 3

QR PASS &
CHECKPOINT
VALIDATION

• HMAC / Token Generation
• Mobile QR Code Rendering
• Host Checkpoint Scanner
• Time Window Verification
• Check-in Transaction Log

Subroutine: generateQrCredential()
Create unique reservation_token & QR signature
Bind token with reservation_id, plate_number, space_id

Render Dynamic In-App QR Pass
Driver displays secure QR barcode on mobile screen

Host Checkpoint Scanner Capture
Host scans QR token (or inputs reservation code)
[POST /api/owner/checkpoints/validate]

Subroutine: validateCheckpointToken()
• Decrypt/Lookup reservation by credential token
• Verify space_id matches authenticated host space
• Verify arrival time <= end_time

Checkpoint Error Feedback
Alert: Invalid Token, Wrong Facility, or Out of Schedule

Subroutine: executeCheckIn()
• UPDATE reservations SET status='checked_in'
• INSERT INTO checkpoint_transactions (type:'check_in')

Database: Log Entry Checkpoint
Insert timestamped entry log to DB

Start Live Parking Session Timer
Driver screen transitions to Active Parking with live countdown

SUBROUTINE 4

OVERSTAY &
PENALTY BILLING
ENGINE

• Actual Duration Computation
• Grace Period Verification
• Multiplier Penalty Rates
• Abandoned Vehicle Flagging
• Consolidated Bill Synthesis

Host Triggers Check-out Scan
Driver presents QR pass upon facility departure
[POST /api/owner/checkpoints/validate]

Subroutine: flagAbandonedVehicle()
Mark is_abandoned=true, notify Admin & Space Owner

Database: Complete Reservation & Bill
• UPDATE reservations SET status='completed',
total_amount=final_amount, overstay_fee=penalty_amount
• INSERT INTO checkpoint_transactions (type:'check_out')

Display Consolidated Statement
Driver & Host receive itemized invoice (Base + Penalty)

SUBROUTINE 5

PAYMENT &
RATING
AGGREGATION

• Multi-Method Payment
• Payment Proof Upload & Audit
• Host Proof Inspection Stream
• Star Rating Submission
• Dynamic Space Rating Recalc

Driver Hands Cash Payment
Cash settled on-site at checkpoint

Subroutine: fetchPaymentProof()
Host streams image [GET .../payment-proof]
Validates reference & marks verified

Subroutine: finalizePaymentState()
UPDATE reservations SET payment_status='paid'
Generate digital tax & transaction receipt

Subroutine: submitFeedback()
Driver rates 1-5 stars and writes review
[POST /driver/reservations/{id}/feedback]

Subroutine: recalculateSpaceRating()
• INSERT INTO reviews (reservation_id, rating, comment)
• UPDATE parking_spaces SET rating = (SELECT AVG(rating) FROM reviews)

Database: Store Review & Aggregate
Insert review row & update parking_spaces.rating

SUBROUTINE 6

REAL-TIME RTC
SIGNALING &
VOICE ENGINE

• Call Session Creation
• Active Call Polling / Events
• SDP Offer/Answer Relay
• ICE Candidate Signal Batch
• Agora / WebRTC Audio Session

Subroutine: createCallSession()
INSERT INTO reservation_calls (status: 'calling')
Generate call channel token & notify host

Host Receives Incoming Call Alert
Screen shows incoming caller info & Accept / Reject CTA
[GET /conversation/calls/active]

Subroutine: relaySignalBatch()
• [POST .../signals] exchange SDP offer / answer
• [GET .../signals?after_id=?] poll ICE candidates

WebRTC / Agora RTC Audio Engine
Bidirectional low-latency audio stream active

Terminate Audio Call
Either party taps End Call [PATCH .../calls/{id}/end]

SUBROUTINE 7

AUDIT LOGGING &
DISPUTE
GOVERNANCE

• Event Interceptor Middleware
• Non-repudiation Audit Records
• Dispute Ticket Lifecycle
• Admin Internal Investigation
• System Health Analytics

Driver / Host Submits Dispute Ticket
File ticket for billing discrepancy or parking conflict
[POST /admin/support-requests]

Subroutine: logSystemAuditEvent()
Intercept action, serialize actor_id, ip_address, route,
and state payload diff into audit buffer

Database: audit_logs & qr_logs
• INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, action, payload)
• INSERT INTO qr_transaction_logs

Admin Monitor Subroutine: fetchActivity()
Admin streams real-time audit logs & pending disputes
[GET /api/admin/activity] & [GET /api/admin/reservations]

Subroutine: applyDisputeResolution()
Update reservation balance, adjust refund/penalty, notify parties

Database: Settle Dispute Status
UPDATE reservations SET dispute_status='resolved'

Subroutine: renderSystemAnalytics()
Compute occupancy rates, revenue totals & audit statistics
